content.description:
What Cognite is Relentless to Achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. Our Moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works.

The Solution Engineer is a hands-on builder on the Customer Land Team, the dedicated pod that delivers a customer's first project, the Quick Start. You work in a cross-functional pod with an Deployment Strategist, a Solution Architect, other Solution Engineers to configure, deploy and operationalize Cognite solutions for customers across oil and gas, manufacturing, life sciences, power and utilities, and related industries. You will work on-site and remotely with customers, understand their desired outcome, and turn it into working applications, agents and data foundations that show value fast.

Every day looks different. As a Solution Engineer, here's what you can expect:

Turn a customer's desired outcome into working software inside the first project, so they see value on the project, not after it.

Build on Cognite Data Fusion: deploy Cognite Flows and Atlas AI agents, and ship web applications customers use on shift.

Make messy industrial data usable: pull it from customer source systems, model it, and put it in context so AI agents can act on it.

Work where the data lives: on site and remotely with customers in oil and gas, manufacturing, life sciences, and power and utilities.

Shape the product: take deployment friction straight to Product and improve the templates and playbooks the next pod will use.

The Ownership You Will Hold

This role is for builders. You'll turn a customer's desired outcome into working applications, agents, and data foundations, inside a small pod that delivers the customer's first project.

Deploy and configure Cognite Flows and Atlas AI agents, and develop web applications on Cognite Data Fusion.

Ingest, transform, and model customer data into performant knowledge graphs.

Contextualize data so use cases run and AI agents can use it.

Cleanse and explore data, and build physical and machine learning models in Python where the use case calls for them.

Apply GenAI techniques to improve decisions in customer use cases.

Support customers after delivery with break/fix and data tasks that set up the next phase.

Contribute to solution templates and playbooks, and give Product direct feedback on deployment friction.

The Impact You Bring

Must have

Builder's toolkit: Python, SQL, and Git, and 1-3 years as a data scientist, data engineer, or solutions engineer.

Quantitative foundation: a degree in computer science, engineering, data science, statistics, or a related field or equivalent experience, with machine learning, statistics, or optimization methods.

AI-native working style: you use tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, and have built with GenAI tooling.

Customer-ready: you have worked with external customers, including on site, and can travel up to 80%.

Pod player: you ask for help early and enjoy sharing what you know.

Strong plus

Industrial instinct: 2+ years in oil and gas, manufacturing, or life sciences, or hands-on experience with Cognite Data Fusion or a comparable industrial data platform.

Value Delivery is building a strategic team focused on converting customers from land to expand. Join us!

A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter

* Competitive compensation

* 401(k) with employer matching

* Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents

* Unlimited PTO

* Paid Parental Leave Program

* Employee Referral Program

Why Cognite

You will work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve problems that actually matter at scale — not hypothetical ones. You'll join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where curiosity and ownership are the norm, not the exception. If you want delivery work you can point to and be proud of, we'd love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.
